findings.evidence: screens-item-steps.jsx:275 `transition: 'all 0.12s'` shorthand animates every animatable property including border-width (1.5→2px), causes layout shift mid-transition. Best practice: explicit transition properties (transform/background-color/border-color/box-shadow).
findings.fix_hint: screens-item-steps.jsx:275 replace `transition: 'all 0.12s'` with `transition: 'transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out'`. Also keep border-width constant (1.5px) — use color/shadow shift to signal selection.
